Next: put real distance between myself and it

I quickly scan my surroundings, noticing the dark silhouette of the beach, the faint sound of seagulls crying, and the faint smell of saltwater in the air. My heart beats faster, pounding against my chest as I rush towards the dense forest that looms at the edge of the beach. The trees seem to stretch out like sentinels, guarding secrets I'm desperate to keep from my mind. I take a deep breath and start walking, the rhythmic pounding of my feet on the sand following me as I disappear into the shadows of the forest.
